summary.text: Nate Uldricks is the Republican candidate for Indiana State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer and Pine Township Board chairman, he won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary over Johannes Poulard.

paragraphs.text: Nate Uldricks graduated from Portage High School and earned degrees from Purdue University (2006), Johns Hopkins University (2010) and the University of Virginia (2017).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation Porter County resident who previously served in the White House Budget Office and the U.S. Department of Defense.
He said he is Pine Township Board Chairman, a volunteer firefighter and a Porter County Parks Foundation board member.
Uldricks said he is running to lower everyday costs, challenge NIPSCO, build the manufacturing economy, strengthen public safety and protect the dunes, lake and farms.
